name: Remgro Limited
summary: Remgro Limited is a principal investment firm. The firm prefers to invest in healthcare, financial services, consumer products, infrastructure, industrial, food, liquor and home care, banking, insurance, industrial, information technology infrastructure services, media, and sport. It considers investments in Africa, UAE, UK, Switzerland, South Africa, and other international countries though investee companies. The firm typically invests in companies with significant influence and board representation.
